This tiny deterministic GGUF is copied byte-for-byte from the Candle fork's
`candle-transformers/tests/fixtures/lfm2-moe/tiny.gguf` at commit 9ec8749d.
Its weights and independent NumPy references are generated by that fixture
directory's `reference.py`. It is synthetic and contains no model downloads
or user data. Here it tests complete hybrid-state and logits cache isolation.
